# Aunt Martha

- **Age:** 75  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P25](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0025)</sub>

- **Role:** housekeeper  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P27](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0027), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P0](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0000)</sub>

- **Family:** [Faith](../character/faith.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Aunt Martha is half blind and deaf. She is also described as being very childish.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P15](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0015)_

## Personality

Aunt Martha is a cranky, fretful, and grumpy old woman who is a poor housekeeper and dislikes fresh air. Despite her disagreeable nature, she was devoted to [Cecilia](../character/cecilia-meredith.md) and possesses skill in knitting thick, coarse stockings. However, she is acknowledged to be a very poor cook.

## History

Raised seventy years prior to attend church regardless of circumstances, Aunt Martha brought up the children under the same principle. While Mr. Meredith was away, she became bedridden, leaving the young girls to manage the manse until she recovered. Later, she unknowingly killed Faith's beloved pet rooster, [Adam](../character/adam.md), to serve for dinner to a visiting minister, sparking Faith's fury.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P10](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0010), [v5 CHAPTER X. > "Don’t you get sassy now. The rooster’s killed and there’s an end of it. I ain’t going to set no strange minister down to a dinner of cold b’iled mutton. I was brought up to know better than that, if I have come down in the world."
>
> — Aunt Martha — [v5 CHAPTER XIX. POOR ADAM! P5](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0005)

> "Don’t you go bothering your poor father. He has troubles enough. And I’m housekeeper here."
>
> — Aunt Martha — [v5 CHAPTER XIX. POOR ADAM! P3](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0003)

> "Thank goodness, John isn’t here. There’s a plenty o’ cold biled meat and bread and you kin try your hand at making porridge."
>
> — Aunt Martha — [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P11](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0011)

>

> "You must worry on till I kin git around,"
>
> — Aunt Martha — [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P11](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0011)

## Relationships

### [Faith](../character/faith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-martha--faith.md)

Aunt Martha is the aunt of [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md). When Martha is bedridden with illness, [Faith](../character/faith.md) attempts to step in to manage the household alongside her sister [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), though the endeavor leads to local gossip. [Faith](../character/faith.md) later flies into a rage at Martha when she learns the elder woman slaughtered her beloved pet rooster, [Adam](../character/adam.md), for dinner.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P10](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0010), [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P35](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0035), [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P43](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0043), +7 more_
